name: Claude Enterprise
risk_tier: Tier 2 — Internal data OK, no regulated customer PII
intended_users: Senior analysts, consultants, research teams, the Hub
restrictions: No raw customer PII; no regulated financial data without DPIA
rationale: My non-negotiable. Best-in-class for complex reasoning, long-document analysis, and refusal-to-fabricate on client-facing work.

name: Claude Code
risk_tier: Tier 1 — Code only, no production secrets
restrictions: No secrets, API keys, or PII in prompts; private mode required
rationale: Bundled under the same Anthropic relationship as Claude Enterprise — one vendor, one observability surface, one contract.

name: ChatGPT Enterprise
risk_tier: Tier 2 — Internal data OK, no regulated customer PII
intended_users: Analysts, client services, ops, executive support
restrictions: No client PII; no regulated financial data without DPIA; tenant-isolated workspace
rationale: Approved productivity copilot. Sanctions and upgrades the three BUs already running ChatGPT Team licenses — turns shadow usage into a governed enterprise workflow.

name: Microsoft 365 Copilot
intended_users: Pilot cohort (50 seats); broader rollout pending Microsoft alignment confirmation
restrictions: Pilot only; tenant-isolated, Purview labels enforced; decision after BU evaluation
rationale: Held under review. If the customer's stack is confirmed Microsoft-aligned in the 2-week BU evaluation, I revisit and consider replacing or complementing ChatGPT Enterprise. Until then, pilot scope only.

name: Portkey
intended_users: AI Enablement Hub, CDAO team, Security
restrictions: All sanctioned model traffic routes through Portkey
rationale: My non-negotiable on observability. Without a single pane of glass on usage, cost, and risk across vendors, governance is a posture, not a practice.

name: Perplexity Enterprise
rationale: Specialized search workflow. Held in pilot; broad rollout deferred to year two pending baseline data.

name: Internal Survey Insight Agent
restrictions: Anonymized inputs only; outputs reviewed by analyst
rationale: Specialized agent — pilot scope only until baseline data justifies broader rollout.

name: Gemini for Google Workspace
restrictions: Blocked: customer runs Microsoft 365; no parallel productivity stack
rationale: Out of scope — my consolidation principle: one productivity baseline, not three.

name: Replit Agent
restrictions: Blocked: cannot meet data residency and SSO requirements at enterprise tier
rationale: Out of scope on security and data residency. Claude Code covers the agentic-coding use case.
